name: McKinley
source:
One of the top CORE army commanders. His brain was moved in into a cyborg body to fight for Gamerica and so he has become a CORE.

Former CEO of a big company. Successfully managed the company, that was established by his dad, and got along with his family. But he had a dark side: he kidnapped people to eat them.

"Noo, zis meat iz so tast' in any wa'! Chew chew... Chomp... Slurp slurp..."
